items.exampleEn: I lost one of my gloves.
I can't find my other sock.
Wear a sweater. It's cold outside.
My grandmother made me a wool scarf.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶幫我織了一條羊毛圍巾。

items.exampleEn: I always carry a small comb in my bag.
items.exampleZh: 我包包裡總是帶著一把小梳子。

items.exampleEn: Take your raincoat. It might rain.
items.exampleZh: 帶著雨衣吧，可能會下雨。

items.sentenceEn: Don't forget your gloves and scarf.
items.sentenceZh: 別忘了你的手套和圍巾。

items.audioEn: It's very cold, so I'm wearing a sweater, a scarf and gloves.
items.audioZh: 天氣很冷，所以我穿了毛衣，戴了圍巾和手套。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼穿戴這麼多？

items.sentenceEn: These socks are too small for me.
He bought his wife a diamond ring.
items.sentenceZh: 他買了一枚鑽石戒指送給太太。

items.stemZh: 在下雨了，穿上你的雨衣。

items.stemEn: Can I borrow your ____? I want to brush my hair.
items.stemZh: 可以借我你的梳子嗎？我想梳一下頭髮。

items.passageEn: Winter was coming, so Emma went shopping for warm clothes. She bought a thick sweater, a long scarf and a pair of gloves. She also needed some new socks. In another shop, she saw a beautiful diamond ring, but it was far too expensive. On her way home, it started to rain. Fortunately, she had her raincoat in her bag.
items.passageZh: 冬天快到了，所以 Emma 去買保暖的衣服。她買了一件厚毛衣、一條長圍巾和一雙手套。她也需要幾雙新襪子。在另一家店，她看到一枚漂亮的鑽石戒指，但實在太貴了。回家的路上開始下雨。幸好她包包裡有雨衣。

questions.questionZh: 回家的路上發生了什麼事？
options: 下雨了，幸好她帶了雨衣
她買了那枚漂亮的鑽石戒指

referenceEn: I need a new pair of socks.
rubricZh: 「一雙」可寫 a pair of＋複數名詞（例如 a pair of socks）；寫 some new socks 也正確

items.promptZh: 這件毛衣很暖和，可是有點重。
referenceEn: This sweater is warm, but it is a bit heavy.
This sweater is very warm but a little heavy.
rubricZh: 「有點重」可寫，例如 a bit heavy、a little heavy 等
轉折可寫，例如 but 等
